data.gender_notes: Haidarah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: The One Who Makes the Way Clear
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word ‘Hadara’, meaning 'to make clear, to show the way, or to make a path easy'. This name symbolizes the one who illuminates the path for others, providing guidance and wisdom. The name Haidarah carries the meaning “The One Who Makes the Way Clear” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Haidarah usually hope their child will grow to embody the one who makes the way clear and live with faith, good character and purpose.
